clips.send: A mom sends this to her sister who takes the same vitamin bottle every day, anger at being sold the same pill for years straight.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most supplement companies sell you the exact same pill, every single day, for the rest of your life.

But you don't eat the same meal for breakfast, lunch and dinner every day. Your body uses different nutrients in different amounts, day to day.

That's why his own supplement line is built differently: thirty days, thirty different capsule formulas, never repeating the same mix twice.

Next time you pick up a bottle, check it. Does the formula ever change, or is every single pill exactly the same?

#kevintrudeau #supplements #vitaminlabel #healthfacts #wholefoodnutrition #labelreading
